notes.title: Update 0.2 released!
notes.content:
We have just released new version with many suggestions of community. 

What's new:
[list]
[*] Bosses now drops magic eggs when killed. You can buy useful items for them, including more health, ammo and new weapons.
[*] Difficulty level can be changed in settings. Play hard level if easy is too easy for you!.
[*] Inverted vertical mouse/pad axis - check option "Invert vertical mouse/pad axis" in settings.
[*] Improved enemies shooting/attacking AI. 
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[/list]
